transcript.text: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for making time for this pre-authorization meeting. As you know, we're here to review the operating plan for the proposed eight-week pilot extending main library hours Monday through Friday from 10:00 p.m. to midnight, with one library employee on duty and standard student-ID access. Before I can sign off on the plan, I need to hear from each of the reviewing offices -- facilities, campus safety, library IT, and finance -- regarding any requirements or concerns you have. Let's go through them one at a time. Could we start with facilities?

transcript.text: I need to raise a campus safety requirement that hasn't been reflected in the operating plan yet. Our campus safety policy requires at least two authorized adults to be present in the building whenever the library remains open after 10:00 p.m. I confirmed this with the evening patrol supervisor earlier this week. The current proposal lists only one library employee on duty, which would not meet that requirement. We'll need to amend the plan to include a second authorized adult for the 10 p.m. to midnight hours.

transcript.text: I need to raise a library IT requirement that hasn't been reflected in the operating plan yet. During a recent system check, I identified a configuration issue with our access-control system: it can support the pilot only if entry is limited to currently enrolled students using college ID cards. If we allow unrestricted access for all standard ID holders after 10:00 p.m., expired and visitor credentials would remain active during those hours. The plan needs to be amended to specify that late-night entry is restricted to currently enrolled students with valid college ID cards.
